text: Go back to the first day of this journey.
prefix: Go back to the first day of this journey.

text: It is a Sunday, in Aziz's first week, and he installs the mobile bank on his one phone.
prefix: It is a Sunday, in Aziz's first week, and he installs the mobile bank on his one phone.

text: All he has is a phone number.
prefix: All he has is a phone number.

text: So how does a phone number become an account that the bank can trust?
prefix: So how does a phone number become an account that the bank can trust?

text: Lesson 7 gave the apps a contract, with one call for each step.
prefix: Lesson 7 gave the apps a contract, with one call for each step.

text: This lesson follows the first of those calls: the registration, from a phone number to level one.
prefix: This lesson follows the first of those calls: the registration, from a phone number to level one.

text: The app opens with two buttons: Register, and Log in.
prefix: The app opens with two buttons: Register, and Log in.

text: On the login screen, a link leads to the registration, and its text is always the same.
prefix: On the login screen, a link leads to the registration, and its text is always the same.

text: That text never depends on the number, so the screen tells nobody if a number already has an account.
prefix: That text never depends on the number, so the screen tells nobody if a number already has an account.

text: Aziz taps Register.
prefix: Aziz taps Register.

text: First, the app shows the terms and the privacy text, in his language.
prefix: First, the app shows the terms and the privacy text, in his language.

text: The text names TAF, the antifraud service of the mobile operators, as a receiver of his phone number and his phone model.
prefix: The text names TAF, the antifraud service of the mobile operators, as a receiver of his phone number and his phone model.

text: Aziz accepts.
prefix: Aziz accepts.

text: Then he types his number and taps Continue.
prefix: Then he types his number and taps Continue.

text: The app sends one request: the number, the language, the version of the terms that Aziz accepted, and a short description of the phone.
prefix: The app sends one request: the number, the language, the version of the terms that Aziz accepted, and a short description of the phone.

text: The description is the platform, the model, the system version and the app version.
prefix: The description is the platform, the model, the system version and the app version.

text: The request also carries its network address.
prefix: The request also carries its network address.

text: The platform checks four facts.
prefix: The platform checks four facts.

text: The number is a real mobile number of Uzbekistan.
prefix: The number is a real mobile number of Uzbekistan.

text: The app is active.
prefix: The app is active.

text: The terms version is the current one for his language, and the platform records his acceptance.
prefix: The terms version is the current one for his language, and the platform records his acceptance.

text: And no limit is reached, which Lesson 9 shows.
prefix: And no limit is reached, which Lesson 9 shows.

text: Now the platform opens a registration record, in the state Started.
prefix: Now the platform opens a registration record, in the state Started.

text: From now on, every text and every code message to Aziz is in his language.
prefix: From now on, every text and every code message to Aziz is in his language.

text: The platform also gives the app a device identifier, and keeps it on the record.
prefix: The platform also gives the app a device identifier, and keeps it on the record.

text: Only this phone can continue this registration.
prefix: Only this phone can continue this registration.

text: Then the platform makes a one-time code.
prefix: Then the platform makes a one-time code.

text: It is random, and it never comes from the number, the time or the phone.
prefix: It is random, and it never comes from the number, the time or the phone.

text: The platform keeps only a fingerprint of the code, so even the database cannot say the code back.
prefix: The platform keeps only a fingerprint of the code, so even the database cannot say the code back.

text: The app gets the lifetime of the code and the number of resends that remain, but never the code itself.
prefix: The app gets the lifetime of the code and the number of resends that remain, but never the code itself.

text: The mobile bank is the master app, so TAF sends the SMS.
prefix: The mobile bank is the master app, so TAF sends the SMS.

text: Its part inside the app checks that the code arrived on this phone, with this SIM card.
prefix: Its part inside the app checks that the code arrived on this phone, with this SIM card.

text: If TAF does not answer, the SMS vendor sends the code instead, and Lesson 10 shows what that changes.
prefix: If TAF does not answer, the SMS vendor sends the code instead, and Lesson 10 shows what that changes.

text: Today the SMS is slow.
prefix: Today the SMS is slow.

text: After a minute, Aziz goes back and taps Register again.
prefix: After a minute, Aziz goes back and taps Register again.

text: A second registration for the same number ends the open one, and its code is void.
prefix: A second registration for the same number ends the open one, and its code is void.

text: So one number has only one open registration at a time.
prefix: So one number has only one open registration at a time.

text: Then two messages arrive, and only the code in the second one is alive.
prefix: Then two messages arrive, and only the code in the second one is alive.

text: Aziz types it.
prefix: Aziz types it.

text: The platform takes a code only from the phone that started the registration.
prefix: The platform takes a code only from the phone that started the registration.

text: A code from another device counts as a wrong entry, even when it is right.
prefix: A code from another device counts as a wrong entry, even when it is right.

text: Here the phone is the same, and the fingerprints match.
prefix: Here the phone is the same, and the fingerprints match.

text: The record moves to Number verified, and the code is void.
prefix: The record moves to Number verified, and the code is void.

text: Then TAF gives its verdict, and today it is Green; Lesson 10 explains the colours.
prefix: Then TAF gives its verdict, and today it is Green; Lesson 10 explains the colours.

text: Only after the verdict does the platform look up the number.
prefix: Only after the verdict does the platform look up the number.

text: It belongs to nobody, so Aziz is a new person.
prefix: It belongs to nobody, so Aziz is a new person.

text: Until the number is verified, the platform makes nothing for it: no consent, no device record, no session.
prefix: Until the number is verified, the platform makes nothing for it: no consent, no device record, no session.

text: Now the app asks for a password.
prefix: Now the app asks for a password.

text: Then the phone rings, and Aziz's mother talks for ten minutes.
prefix: Then the phone rings, and Aziz's mother talks for ten minutes.

text: In the background, the phone closes the app.
prefix: In the background, the phone closes the app.

text: When Aziz opens it again, the app asks the platform for the state of its registration.
prefix: When Aziz opens it again, the app asks the platform for the state of its registration.

text: The answer is Number verified, so the app opens the password screen again, not the start.
prefix: The answer is Number verified, so the app opens the password screen again, not the start.

text: Only the phone that started the registration gets this answer; any other device gets the state Expired.
prefix: Only the phone that started the registration gets this answer; any other device gets the state Expired.

text: Aziz types a password, and then the same password a second time.
prefix: Aziz types a password, and then the same password a second time.

text: The two entries differ by one letter, and the platform refuses.
prefix: The two entries differ by one letter, and the platform refuses.

text: He types them again, and now they match.
prefix: He types them again, and now they match.

text: The rules for a good password, and how the platform keeps it, are in Lesson 11.
prefix: The rules for a good password, and how the platform keeps it, are in Lesson 11.

text: Now four things appear at once.
prefix: Now four things appear at once.

text: A customer at level one.
prefix: A customer at level one.

text: An app account in the mobile bank.
prefix: An app account in the mobile bank.

text: A device record for his phone, known, but not yet trusted.
prefix: A device record for his phone, known, but not yet trusted.

text: And a session for this phone.
prefix: And a session for this phone.

text: The registration record is now Onboarded.
prefix: The registration record is now Onboarded.

text: The platform sends the message registration complete as an SMS at once.
prefix: The platform sends the message registration complete as an SMS at once.

text: A push follows when the phone gives its push token to the platform.
prefix: A push follows when the phone gives its push token to the platform.

text: A registration that never reaches level one does not wait forever.
prefix: A registration that never reaches level one does not wait forever.

text: After the configured time, the record expires.
prefix: After the configured time, the record expires.

text: The platform deletes its data and keeps only the audit events.
prefix: The platform deletes its data and keeps only the audit events.

text: A new try starts from the beginning.
prefix: A new try starts from the beginning.

text: Now take the slow SMS again, and suppose that Aziz types the code from the first message.
prefix: Now take the slow SMS again, and suppose that Aziz types the code from the first message.

text: Does it work?
prefix: Does it work?

text: No: the second registration ended the first one, so only the newest code is alive, and the old code counts as a wrong entry.
prefix: No: the second registration ended the first one, so only the newest code is alive, and the old code counts as a wrong entry.

text: Two entries, and a link that never depends on the number.
prefix: Two entries, and a link that never depends on the number.

text: The terms first, then one request, four checks and a registration record.
prefix: The terms first, then one request, four checks and a registration record.

text: A code through TAF, taken only from the phone that started.
prefix: A code through TAF, taken only from the phone that started.

text: One open registration for each number, and a restart that continues where it stopped.
prefix: One open registration for each number, and a restart that continues where it stopped.

text: A password two times, then level one, and a message that says so.
prefix: A password two times, then level one, and a message that says so.

text: The code that Aziz typed lives on only as a fingerprint, and Lesson 9 shows the limits around it: its lifetime, its tries and the cool-downs.
prefix: The code that Aziz typed lives on only as a fingerprint, and Lesson 9 shows the limits around it: its lifetime, its tries and the cool-downs.
